title: Armed clash between Asayish and National Defense forces in Qamishli
reason: Armed confrontation, not a civilian public assembly.
notes: Kurdistan24 reports fighting between Asayish and a regime-affiliated National Defense force. North Press later describes a prior-week clash in Qamishli. Combat deaths or injuries are not protest casualties.

title: Asayish–National Defense firefight near Hasakah security complex
reason: Armed combat is not itself a civilian protest; keep it separate from the reported attempted march candidate E004.
notes: North Press reports a firefight after pro-regime demonstrators attempted to march toward an Asayish checkpoint and one government-affiliated fighter killed. No casualty or combat action is transferred to E004.

title: Idlib teachers protest unpaid entitlements
reason: Outside the January unit window; no earlier January physical onset or continuity was found.
notes: North Press describes “dozens” of teachers outside the Idlib Education Directorate and a demand for salary arrears. The attendance threshold remains unclear, and the Salvation Government is a de facto authority; this is a neighboring-month lead, not a January continuation.

title: Western Aleppo countryside schools strike over education-sector funding
reason: Outside the January unit window and reported as school/work stoppages rather than a public assembly.
notes: North Press says eight schools in western Aleppo countryside went on strike. School count is not protester turnout, and no January onset or physical continuity is documented.
